text:
Kathy is a pretermitted spouse despite the prenuptial agreement, and because Bill leaves lineal descendants who are not Kathy's, she takes 50% of the estate; Tommy takes the pasture land and Tommy and Julie split the residue. The condominium does not pass to Kathy by survivorship because the attempted tenancy by the entirety deed fails—Bill was married but the homestead/investment property issue aside, the will's devise to Julie controls absent a valid TBE.

CONFIDENCE: 60
